scripts.fmt: pnpm -r fmt && oxfmt --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json .stylelintrc.json
scripts.fmt:check: pnpm -r fmt:check && oxfmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json .oxfmtrc.json .oxlintrc.json .stylelintrc.json
scripts.test: pnpm --filter client test && pnpm --filter ctf-server-e2etest test:unit
